necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations, raising clinical concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1). Due to the intermittent nature of these symptoms, continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities is required to capture potential arrhythmic events. Therefore, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was medically necessary to evaluate the underlying cause of the syncope (R55) and ensure patient safety.
